title: Checks for types used in structs, parameters and let declarations above a certain complexity threshold.
summary: Too complex types make the code less readable. Consider using a type definition to simplify them. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.

title: Looks for calls to .type_id() on a Box<dyn _>.
summary: This almost certainly does not do what the user expects and can lead to subtle bugs. Calling .type_id() on a Box<dyn Trait> returns a fixed TypeId of the Box itself, rather than returning the TypeId of the underlying type behind the trait object. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: This lint warns about unnecessary type repetitions in trait bounds
summary: Repeating the type for every bound makes the code less readable than combining the bounds Clippy puts this lint in the nursery group, at the level allow.
